events.title: April increase announced
events.summary: Hetzner announces higher prices from 1 April 2026 for new orders and existing products.
events.quote: The price changes take effect on 1 April 2026 and are for both new orders and existing products.

events.title: Increase #1: everyone, including existing servers
events.summary: Cloud prices rise for all servers (EU CPX22 €5.99 → €7.99, CX23 €2.99 → €3.99; US CPX11 €4.49 → €5.99, excl. VAT). No grandfathering.
events.quote: The price changes will take effect on 1 April 2026 for both new orders and existing products.

events.title: June increase announced
events.summary: Hetzner announces a second increase for new orders and rescales, effective 15 June 2026.
events.quote: The changes apply exclusively to new orders and rescales of existing servers

events.title: Increase #2: new orders and rescales only
events.summary: From 15 June 2026, 8:00 CEST, every new cloud server and every rescale is billed at the new list (EU CPX22 €19.49, US CPX11 €17.49, excl. VAT and IPv4). Servers ordered before keep their price.
events.quote: The price adjustment took effect for new orders and cloud instance rescales starting on the 15 June 2026; 8 AM CEST

items.do: Don’t rescale a pre-June server — up or down
items.why: Hetzner bills the current list after “Rescaling (regardless of whether the server is scaled up or down).” A smaller plan can still cost more than your locked price.

items.do: Don’t delete and restore to “fix” a plan
items.why: “Restoring a deleted server” also moves that server onto current pricing.

items.do: Don’t move the server into a project billed in another currency
items.why: “Transferring a server to another project with a different currency” switches it to the current scheme in the target currency.

items.do: Do rebuild in place, or move to a same-currency project, if you only need a clean image or tidy projects
items.why: Hetzner lists “Rebuilding a server” and “Transferring a server to another project with the same currency” as actions that do not change the price.

items.do: Prefer adding a second box over growing a locked one
items.why: A grandfathered CCX13 kept at the pre-June price plus a new Regular Performance CPX22 is still cheaper than rescaling that CCX13 up to today’s CCX23 — see the add-a-box row above (math from Hetzner’s own June list + today’s Regular Performance page).
